notes:
Valheim has NO native remote console. Every command here comes from the ValheimRcon BepInEx plugin (Tristan/ValheimRcon), so this manifest applies ONLY to the modded variant — the vanilla `valheim` service cannot be administered remotely at all, by anything.

RECONCILED against the running server's own `list` on 2026-08-29, which is the ground truth for what this build accepts. That pass corrected two things authored from upstream documentation: `banSteamId` does not exist on this build, and `teleport` takes coordinates only rather than a steamid plus coordinates. Re-run the `list` query and diff after any plugin upgrade — the docs and the build have already disagreed once.

`unverified` now means EXECUTION is unconfirmed, not existence: every command's name and signature come from the live `list`, but only `list`, `server_stats` and `time` have actually been run. Clear the flag on a command once it has been executed and seen to take effect.

`server_stats` and `time` carry parsing patterns derived from real replies. The rest deliberately carry none and return their raw text — inventing regexes for output nobody has seen produces empty fields that read as 'the server told us nothing'.

Identifiers: player commands take a Steam ID or player name; object commands take the `id:userid` pair `findObjects` reports. Coordinates are Valheim world coordinates (x, z horizontal; y vertical).

Optional flags beyond the required arguments are named in each description but not modelled, because a manifest template requires every placeholder it declares. Use the raw `rcon` tool for those.

commands.name: kick
commands.description: Disconnect a player. They can rejoin immediately.

commands.name: ban
commands.description: Ban a player by name or Steam ID. Persists in the ban list.

commands.name: unban
commands.description: Remove a ban.

commands.name: add_admin
commands.description: Grant admin privileges. An admin can use in-game console commands, so this is a privilege escalation.

commands.name: remove_admin
commands.description: Revoke admin privileges.

commands.name: add_permitted
commands.description: Add a player to the permitted (allow) list.

commands.name: remove_permitted
commands.description: Remove a player from the permitted list. If the list is in use, this locks them out.

commands.name: disconnect_all
commands.description: Disconnect every connected player at once. Ends the session for everyone.

commands.name: find_player
commands.description: Look up one player and show their details.

commands.name: give
commands.description: Give an item to a player. Accepts further flags (-quality, -variant, -durability) via the raw rcon tool.

item.description: Valheim item prefab name, e.g. Wood or SwordIron

commands.name: heal
commands.description: Restore health to a player.

commands.name: damage
commands.description: Deal damage to a player. Can kill them, which in Valheim means a corpse run and skill loss.

commands.name: teleport
commands.description: Teleport the player to world coordinates. NOTE the live build takes coordinates ONLY — no player id — so it acts on the player the plugin resolves, not one you choose. Reconciled against the server's own `list`; upstream docs describe a steamid argument this build does not accept.

commands.name: spawn
commands.description: Spawn an object or creature at coordinates. Extra flags (-count, -level, -tamed, -rotation, -radius) are available via the raw rcon tool.

prefab.description: Prefab name, e.g. Deer or Greydwarf

commands.name: find_objects
commands.description: Find objects matching a filter. Pass a filter such as '-prefab Beehive -near 100' or '-tag mytag'.

commands.name: delete_objects
commands.description: Delete objects matching a filter. IRREVERSIBLE and unbounded — a loose filter can delete a base. Find first with find_objects and delete by the exact ids it returns.

filter.description: Selection flags: -near <x> <y> <z> <radius>, -zone <x> <y>, -prefab, -creator, -id <id:userid>, -tag, -force. Required: never run this bare.

commands.name: modify_object
commands.description: Change an object's properties (position, rotation, health, tag).

id.description: Object id in id:userid form, from find_objects

commands.name: say
commands.description: Broadcast a chat message to every player.

commands.name: show_message
commands.description: Show a centred on-screen notification to every player. More intrusive than chat — use for shutdown warnings.

commands.name: ping
commands.description: Place a map ping at coordinates, visible to players.

commands.name: show_container
commands.description: Show the contents of a container.

id.description: Container id in id:userid form, from find_objects

commands.name: add_item_to_container
commands.description: Put an item into a container.

commands.name: remove_item_from_container
commands.description: Take an item out of a container. Destroys it rather than moving it anywhere.

commands.name: clear_container
commands.description: Empty a container completely. IRREVERSIBLE — a player's chest contents are gone.

commands.name: start_event
commands.description: Trigger a random event (a raid) at coordinates. Names come from the events_list query.

commands.name: stop_event
commands.description: End the active random event.

commands.name: save
commands.description: Force a world save. Worth running before a deliberate restart — the world-sync sidecar mirrors what is ON DISK, so an unsaved session is not in the mirror.

commands.name: add_global_key
commands.description: Set a world progression flag (e.g. a boss defeat). Changes what spawns and what the world does, globally and for everyone.

commands.name: remove_global_key
commands.description: Clear a world progression flag. Can undo recorded progression for the whole server.

commands.name: console_command
commands.description: Run an arbitrary server console command. The escape hatch for anything this manifest does not model — and correspondingly unbounded.

queries.name: list
queries.description: The plugin's own list of available commands. GROUND TRUTH for this manifest: run it first on a new deploy and reconcile anything that differs, since every command here was authored from documentation rather than from the running build.

queries.name: players
queries.description: Online players with their positions and zones.

queries.name: server_stats
queries.description: Player count, FPS and memory usage.

queries.name: time
queries.description: Current in-game time and day number.

queries.name: current_event
queries.description: The random event currently running, if any.

queries.name: logs
queries.description: The last few lines of server log. For anything longer use the server_logs tool, which reads CloudWatch.
